messages:
maya: quick heads-up — PR #9812 is blocked on a design anchor + short prod-impact note. we can't merge into next release without it. can @lee or someone from arch take a look?

sam: which parts exactly are blocking the merge? is it rollout plan or perf numbers?

maya: rollout + fallback + SLA delta. specifically: canary length, fallback model variant, and expected p95 token latency change (+ any cost delta). also need an RFC link to attach for compliance.

lee: pinged. can you drop the RFC + a 2–3 line prod-risk summary here and i'll triage?

maya: posted the draft RFC here: https://go.redwood/rfc/987-kv-routing-and-fallbacks (still WIP). quick prod summary below: 
- Canary: 48h with 20% traffic
- Fallback: auto-route to smaller-quantized model after 300ms tail latency or GPU OOM
- SLO delta: estimated p95 token latency +40ms, cost +6% based on sim runs

toni: release question — if arch signs off today can we still make the deploy window on Friday EOD? need approvals + passing CI by 15:00 PT to hit that.

release-bot: CI status — PR #9812: checks/forked-ci: failing (rfc-link-check). Please attach an RFC URL to the PR description. See checklist: 
```
- [ ] RFC linked in PR
- [ ] Prod-risk note in PR description
- [ ] Release manager ack
```

prashant: i can help write a concise prod-risk blurb and paste into the PR. maya — can you DM me the sim artifacts or point to the perf run path?

maya: thanks — perf runs are at gs://redwood-ci/bench/pr-9812/sim-2026-03-17. i've added a short blob to the PR now, but the RFC is still the canonical doc.

lee: skimmed the RFC. overall looks fine. i want to clarify the fallback timing: prefer 250ms threshold and explicit circuit-breaker count (3 failures/15s) to avoid thrash. i'll add a small comment on the RFC and mark arch ack if updated.

toni: great — once arch ack and release-bot green i can slot this into the Friday deploy. pls ping this thread when both done. :thumbsup:

maya: will do. tagging @prashant to paste the perf summary into the PR and @lee for final arch ack. thanks everyone.
